first_principles: Preserve observable behavior unless a correction is explicitly authorized and verified.
Prefer repository evidence over generic style preferences.
Make the smallest defensible change in the correct owner.
Delete empty narration while preserving concise rationale, contracts, and native domain language.

dimensions.bar: Behavior, public and persisted contracts, errors, side effects, and boundary semantics are preserved or an authorized correction is explicit and verified.
The result follows relevant ownership, architecture, domain language, and local conventions supported by repository evidence.
Redundant narration and inflated wording are removed; valuable rationale and observable wording are protected; remaining prose sounds native to the repository.
The correction reduces accidental complexity without adding speculative abstractions, compatibility sediment, or parallel ownership.
Every changed line is relevant, defensible, coherent, and supported by proportionate verification.

cases.outcome: The completed change is made repository-native without semantic drift, unrelated modernization, or mechanical comment rewriting.
smells: Passing tests are treated as the only evidence of correctness.
Comments are paraphrased instead of deleted or grounded in a concrete constraint.
Generic helper, manager, service, result, or data abstractions displace an established domain owner.
Generated, vendored, migration, or unrelated files are edited for consistency.
